rows.text: On 19 April 1999 the Secretary-General laid on the Table Vajpayee's letter dated 17 April 1999 to the President tendering his own resignation and that of his Council of Ministers.

locator.page_heading: XII Lok Sabha Debates, Session IV, Monday, April 19, 1999

rows.text: The papers include the President's letter dated 17 April 1999 to Vajpayee accepting his resignation and that of his colleagues.
The President's letter of 17 April 1999 requests Vajpayee to continue in office till alternative arrangements are made.
